outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmentation/model rendering of preconoidal rings and actin filaments from cryo-ET data, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a 3D schematic/segmentation model showing cytoplasmic actin bundles and pellicular actin structures, not a data plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with highlighted filaments, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data.
Panel D is an illustrative schematic/3D model of nuclear, cytosolic and pellicular F-actin, not a data plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged cryo-ET volume (subtomogram average image), not a bar/box/scatter plot requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a specific observed structure (N=2 locations noted in caption), not a summary plot of averaged data.
